help.chooseDocumentTypeStart: Choose the Document Type to start.
help.chooseHowDocumentNumbersLookEach: Choose how document numbers look for each document type. Build the format from your own text and parts such as the year, month or a running number; the preview shows the result. Publishing a new version keeps the running number, and documents already created keep their numbers.
help.chooseWhoToldWhenSomethingHappens: Choose who is told when something happens (Rules) and what they read (Messages). Subscription and billing notifications are managed by the platform.
help.clickAddCursorFieldYouWriting: Click to add at the cursor of the field you are writing, or drag into a field.
help.codeDocPartShowsEG: The code the DOC part shows, e.g. PO.
help.conditionNestedGroupsKeptExactly: This condition has nested groups and is kept exactly as it is.
help.cursorInsideLabelBlockFieldsInserted: Cursor is inside a {{label}} block — fields can be inserted.
help.designHowEachDocumentMovesBetween: Design how each document moves between its statuses. Open a workflow to see it as cards and arrows; New Draft lets you add, remove or redirect transitions. A published workflow applies to documents created after publishing — documents already in progress keep their workflow.
help.designHowEachPrintedDocumentLooks: Design how each printed document looks. Write and format text like in a word processor and add information such as the vehicle registration or the list of jobs from the cards; the preview shows the result with sample data. Documents already printed keep their layout.
help.documentNumberingUsedListContainsEvery: The document this numbering is used for. The list contains every document the system numbers.
help.endStatusNoTransitionLeadsOut: End status: no transition leads out of it.
help.exampleFirstNumberTodaySDate: Example of the first number with today's date. Real numbers are created by the system when a document is saved.
help.ifRecordStillOpenAfterWaiting: If the record is still open after the waiting time, the escalation recipients are notified once.
help.nameNumberingConfigurationEGPurchase: A name for this numbering configuration, e.g. Purchase Order Jakarta.
help.nameTemplateEGWorkOrder: A name for this template, e.g. Work Order with company logo text.
help.numberDigitsRunningNumber1Max: Number of digits of the running number (1–{{max_sequence_digits}}); 6 gives 000001.
help.printedDocumentTemplateListContainsEvery: The printed document this template is for. The list contains every document the system can print.
help.providedSystemProtectedCannotChangedCrea: Provided by the system and protected — it cannot be changed. Create your own rule for the same event to notify other people.
help.publishedWorkflowLayoutOnly: Published workflow: you can rearrange the cards; to change transitions create a New Draft.
help.recipientsHint: Who receives the notification. Several rows are combined; each person receives it once.
help.sampleNumberFormatProducesRealRunning: Sample number this format produces (the real running number is not used)
help.sectionRepeats: Repeats its content once for every {{section}} row of the document.
help.selectStatusArrowConfigure: Select a status or an arrow to configure it.

help.systemDefaultReadOnlyUseNew: System Default: read-only. Use New Draft to change it.
help.templateUsesLayoutVisualEditorCannot: This template uses a layout the visual editor cannot show exactly.

help.transitionCannotStartEndSameStatus: A transition cannot start and end at the same status.
help.typeOwnTextEGRpo: Type your own text (e.g. RPO-) and add the parts below. Click a card to insert it where the cursor is, or drag it into the Format. A part can be used more than once.
help.whatHappensSystemSendsNotification: What happens in the system that sends this notification.
help.whenRunningNumberStartsAgainBeginning: When the running number starts again from the beginning.
help.withoutConditionsNotificationSentEveryTi: Without conditions the notification is sent every time the event happens.
